lines.t:
You gather force without using
{{part}} actions, right?

{{part|cap}} performance rises a little in
line with the stored force, right?

Charging has no {{prep}} or {{cooldown}};
wait in the {{command_area}} a while.

And remember: while Charging you
<c:ff00ff>can't evade<c>.

To Charge, press the $ｸ button and
choose Charge, right?

Once chosen, confirm with the $*
button.
